question: Chand Bardai's famous literary work ________, mentions Prithviraj Chauhan's love story and heroic deeds.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prithviraj Raso**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Prithviraj Raso** is an epic poem written by the poet Chand Bardai.
 
• This literary work narrates the life of the legendary Rajput king Prithviraj Chauhan.
 
• It includes the love story of Prithviraj Chauhan and Sanyogita.
 
• The poem also describes Prithviraj Chauhan's heroic deeds, battles, and his eventual capture and death.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prithviraj Chauhan**

 
 
• He was a Rajput king of the Chauhan dynasty, who ruled the kingdom of Ajmer and Delhi in northern India during the latter half of the 12th century.
 
• Prithviraj Chauhan is known for his valiant battles against the Muslim invader Muhammad Ghori.
 
• He is celebrated in various folk tales and ballads for his courage and chivalry.
 
 
 
• **Chand Bardai**
 
 
• Chand Bardai was a court poet of Prithviraj Chauhan and a close friend.
 
• He composed the epic poem Prithviraj Raso, which is considered one of the first works in the Hindi language.
 
• The poem provides a detailed account of Prithviraj Chauhan's life, from his early years to his death.
 
 
 
• **Other Works Mentioned**
 
 
• **Harakeli Nataka:** A Sanskrit play written by King Bhoja of Dhar.
 
• **Abhidhana Chintamani:** A lexicographical work by Hemachandra.
 
• **Rajamartanda:** A commentary on the Yoga Sutras of Patanjali, attributed to King Bhoja.
